mocked_apis_list: Stripe payment processing - subscriptions created directly in DB without actual payment
Razorpay payment processing - subscriptions created directly in DB without actual payment

backend_endpoints: GET /api/subscription/plans - Returns all 6 plans with correct structure and pricing
GET /api/subscription/current - Returns user's current subscription (free by default)
POST /api/subscription/create - Creates subscription with trial period support
POST /api/subscription/cancel - Cancels subscription immediately or at period end
GET /api/subscription/check-feature/{feature_name} - Checks feature access (recipe_search, premium_recipes, diabetes_module, etc.)
GET /api/subscription/stats - Returns subscription statistics (MRR, ARR, counts)
frontend_components: Pricing page header with 'Unlock Your Culinary Potential' title
4 pricing cards displayed per billing cycle (Free + 3 paid plans)
MOST POPULAR badge on Premium Annual
BEST VALUE badge on Chef Pro Annual
Feature comparison table with 12 features across 4 plan columns
